    <p>{`doesn't work anymore: Google has been progressively killing direct image serving from Drive. The lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/ trick is also unreliable now;`}</p>
    <h1>{`Problem`}</h1>
    <p>{`Recently getting more and more lazy to organize images through blog folders. I know it has a lot of neat image caching/optimization features. Link to Google Drive seems to be a convenient way for me sometimes.`}</p>
    <p>{`Yet, haunted by this issue of converting:`}</p>
    <blockquote>
      <p parentName="blockquote"><a parentName="p" {...{
          "href": "https://drive.google.com/file/d/%7BID%7D/view?usp=sharing"
        }}>{`https://drive.google.com/file/d/{ID}/view?usp=sharing`}</a></p>
    </blockquote>
    <p>{`to something that actually renders as an image.`}</p>
    <h1>{`Old Solution (Broken)`}</h1>
    <p>{`The old trick was converting to:`}</p>
    <blockquote>
      <p parentName="blockquote"><a parentName="p" {...{
          "href": "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=%7BID%7D"
        }}>{`https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id={ID}`}</a></p>
    </blockquote>
    <p>{`Google killed this. It no longer serves images directly. Don't use it.`}</p>
    <h1>{`New Solution`}</h1>
    <p>{`The working format now is:`}</p>
    <blockquote>
      <p parentName="blockquote"><a parentName="p" {...{
          "href": "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/%7BID%7D"
        }}>{`https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/{ID}`}</a></p>
    </blockquote>
    <p>{`So the Ultisnips snippet becomes:`}</p>
    <div {...{
      "className": "gatsby-highlight",
      "data-language": "text"
    }}><pre parentName="div" {...{
        "className": "language-text"
      }}><code parentName="pre" {...{
          "className": "language-text"
        }}>{`snippet gimg "google image"
![\${0:\${VISUAL}}](\${1:\`!v
substitute(getreg("*"), "https://drive.google.com/file/d/\\\\(.*\\\\)/view.*", "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/\\\\1", "g")
\`})
endsnippet`}</code></pre></div>
    <p>{`Same idea — grabs the clipboard, strips the Drive share URL down to just the ID, and builds the `}<code parentName="p" {...{
        "className": "language-text"
      }}>{`lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/{ID}`}</code>{` link. Feel free to tailor the line after `}<code parentName="p" {...{
        "className": "language-text"
      }}>{`!v`}</code>{` to your need.`}</p>
    <p>{`Note: make sure the file is shared publicly ("Anyone with the link can view") in Google Drive, otherwise the image won't load.`}</p>

    </MDXLayout>;
